_about: Noun cells spelled by hand where the generator fails, each with why; gated like generated forms and never over the Quran's own spelling (fil.nouns.table.with_documented). Keys: lemma|root → number|state|case.

S|definite|NOM.why: CAMeL writes a case vowel on the final alif (الْعَصاُ); a noun ending in a long alif shows no case

S|definite|ACC.why: as the nominative: the long alif shows no case

S|definite|GEN.why: as the nominative: the long alif shows no case
